text:
Tara: Heads up — need to borrow 2 x A100s in us-west1 for a customer demo tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can we soft-claim from the standby pool? Ticket INF-4821 opened. @Leo @Sujan
Leo: How long will you need them? ETA back on release?
Tara: ~2.5h total (warmup + run). Back by ~13:30 PT latest. It's the model-sweep infra, low mem but needs GPU compute.
Sujan: Standby pool shows 0 A100s free in us-west1 right now, only A40s. Vendor partner has 4x A100 available but they require a PO for short-term borrow. ops-bot, can you post current inventory snapshot?
ops-bot: inventory-snapshot -> us-west1: A100(0), A40(3), H100(2). Standby: A100(0).
Leo: If vendor needs a PO, Finance needs an approver and cost center. @finance-bot can you advise on express PO routing?
finance-bot: We can do PO-express for <$10k. Need cost center + approver email. Turnaround ~2-4h if weekday and approver is responsive.
Tara: Cost center ENG-DEMO, approver @Leo. Estimated vendor fee ~$3,200 for 4 hours. I'll open the PR/PO now (if we go vendor route).
Sujan: Fallback option — can we run on A40 with reduced batch size? Might be slower but could avoid PO. Tara, could you run a quick smoke test on an A40 by 18:00 today?
Tara: Yep, will spin a nightly smoke on A40 tonight and report results. If A40 passes we'll skip PO. If not, PR/PO submitted.
Leo: :thumbsup: Also, once PR is in, ping the vendor contact (kirill@partner) so they can tentatively hold the racks.
Tara: Filed PR #PO-7712 and emailed kirill. If finance clears, can ops reserve 2 A100s tentatively for 06:30 PT tomorrow? @ops-bot please hold until PO confirmation.
ops-bot: Reservation queued: hold-2-A100s-us-west1-06:30PT -> pending PO confirmation (reservation id resv-9921).
Sujan: Thanks. If anything blocks or PR stalls, escalate to @infra-oncall so we don't lose the window.
Tara: Will update thread after the smoke test and once finance responds. Thanks all!
